source_text: Western anti-circumcision advocates, including organizations such as Doctors Opposing Circumcision, have drawn criticism for opposing voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs in sub-Saharan Africa despite randomized controlled trials (RCTs) from 2005–2007 in South Africa, Kenya, and Uganda demonstrating a 51–60% reduction in HIV acquisition risk among heterosexual men.
